prototype-windowed
==================

Requirements:
- Prototype (2009)
- PrototypeFix 1.8 by emoose

Installation:
1. Install PrototypeFix 1.8 normally.
2. In the game folder, rename the original:
      prototype_fix.asi
   to:
      prototype_fix_original.dll
3. Copy dist/prototype_fix.asi and dist/prototype_fix.ini from this repository
   into the game folder.
4. Launch the game normally.

Expected result:
- Windowed mode
- Normal Windows title bar and borders
- Movable and resizable window
- Minimize / maximize / close buttons
- Initial 1920x1080 size
- Automatic centering

Important:
Keep BorderlessWindow = true in prototype_fix.ini. PrototypeFix needs that
code path to force the game into windowed mode. The wrapper restores the
normal frame after the game window has been created.

Diagnostics:
prototype_window_frame.log is written to the game folder.
